answer: The nebula test I would run is Bond with a cooldown withdrawal queue: an exit queue that takes thirty days to clear, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so an exit queue that takes thirty days to clear stays private; the yarrow is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the terrace of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
